integrity.claim_scope: uniform near-square-root maximal bracket bound and sharp polynomial exponent
integrity.computations: exact finite checker supplements but does not prove the general theorem

scientific_limitations: The subpolynomial factor exp(C_epsilon (log log(N+e^e))^2) is not asserted sharp.
Only independent static, uniformly elliptic Bernoulli coefficients and fair driving signs are covered.
The polynomial optimality statement is minimax over profiles, established using the fair profile.
title: A near-square-root quenched bracket rate for elliptic Pascal-sign walks
